Tints: highlight, tag and avatar

Soft colour washes for emphasis and identity: a highlighted phrase, a tag's colour, an avatar's background. Tints decorate; they never carry meaning on their own.

CSS: css/components/tint.css. Classes: .al-highlight, .al-tag, .al-avatar, .al-avatar--lg, .al-badge; colour set with data-tint.

Anatomy

<mark class="al-highlight" data-tint="teal">accessible</mark>
<span class="al-avatar" data-tint="yellow" aria-hidden="true">MI</span>

Variants and sizes

One per data-tint value shown in the showcase's Tints section. Avatars come in default and --lg.

States

Static.

Keyboard

Not focusable.

ARIA

<mark> for highlights. An avatar beside a visible name is aria-hidden; on its own, give it the person's name.

Right to left

Follows the reading direction.

Do

  • Pair every tint with words.
  • Keep text on a tint at the contrast checked in docs/contrast.md.

Don't

  • Use a tint as a status; use a badge's word.
  • Highlight more than a few phrases on a page.

Tokens

--al-color-surface-sunk, --al-color-text, --al-color-tint-blue-bg, --al-color-tint-blue-ink, --al-color-tint-cyan-bg, --al-color-tint-cyan-ink, --al-color-tint-green-bg, --al-color-tint-green-ink, --al-color-tint-orange-bg, --al-color-tint-orange-ink, --al-color-tint-pink-bg, --al-color-tint-pink-ink, --al-color-tint-purple-bg, --al-color-tint-purple-ink, --al-color-tint-teal-bg, --al-color-tint-teal-ink, --al-color-tint-yellow-bg, --al-color-tint-yellow-ink, --al-radius-full, --al-radius-sm, --al-text-lg, --al-text-sm, --al-weight-semibold. (Inside, [data-tint] sets --_tint-bg and --_tint-ink, private to the component.)
